sonnet.problem: The right answer 'His conscience' is an inner faculty, while both wrong answers ('His neighbors', 'His servants') are people. The right answer stands out and can be found by elimination.
sonnet.rule: All the answers are the same kind of thing, about the same length and the same tone. None are silly.

sonnet.problem: The question turns Job's 'will be buried by the plague' into the present-tense 'his survivors are buried by the plague'. That changes the time the text gives.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added. A prediction stays a prediction

sonnet.problem: Verse 17 says the silver 'will be divided by the innocent'. The card says 'his silver gets divided up by the innocent', which changes the future tense to the present.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added. A prediction stays a prediction
